title: Consistent Baby Mobs
description: Make the babies consistent with the adults!
body:
## Make the babies consistent with the adults!
[View the pack on my website!](https://ewanhowell.com/resourcepacks/consistent-baby-mobs)




In Minecraft 26.1, Mojang updated the baby mobs to have their own unique textures and models, but now there is no consistency between them and the adults at all! This pack fixes Mojang's terrible inconsistencies and makes the babies consistent with the adults again!
